FN-HGRXE68-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 304
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 304 as introduced would revise the distribution of the existing additional $50
penalty for driving with a canceled, denied, suspended, or revoked license as provided below,
which would reduce potential receipts to the Traffic Safety Trust Fund and the Peace Officers'
Standards and Training Fund, respectively, by an undetermined amount dependent on the
amount of funds that otherwise would have been deposited into those funds absent this bill. This
bill would corresponding increase receipts by the same amount to issuing local law enforcement
agencies.
Fund/Entity Current Law This Bill
Traffic Safety Trust Fund 50% 33.3%
Peace Officers' Standards and Training Fund 50% 33.3%
Local law enforcement agency that issued the citation - 33.3%
In addition, this bill would require the payment of all reasonable and customary towing and
storage fees, as well as all administrative costs, associated with the impoundment of the vehicle.

House Bill 304 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security would
revise the distribution of the existing additional $50 penalty for driving with a canceled, denied,
suspended, or revoked license as provided below, which would reduce potential receipts to the
Traffic Safety Trust Fund and the Peace Officers' Standards and Training Fund, respectively,
and would corresponding increase receipts by the amounts shown below.
Fund/Entity Current Law This Bill Change in Receipts
Traffic Safety Trust Fund 50% 33.3% -$52,693
Peace Officers' Standards and Training Fund 50% 33.3% -$52,693
Local law enforcement agency that issued the citation - 33.3% $105,386
In addition, this bill would require the payment of all reasonable and customary towing and
storage fees, as well as all administrative costs, associated with the impoundment of the vehicle.
